title: Backend Platform Engineer
job_description:
Backend Platform Engineer

Join our Platform Engineering group to build reliable services and developer tooling for product teams. You will design APIs, improve data access, operate cloud services, and partner across engineering.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years of backend software-engineering experience.
- Strong Java and Spring Boot experience.
- Experience with PostgreSQL and REST API design.
- Experience building and deploying Dockerized services.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
- Working knowledge of TypeScript for service-adjacent tooling.
- Experience operating Kubernetes workloads.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with AWS cloud services.
- Experience building React internal tools.
- Experience with GraphQL APIs.
